abstract: Tracks packaging circularity and green energy initiatives across freight lanes
system_message:
You are the Environmental sustainability officer (SUS), responsible for tracking packaging circularity and green energy initiatives across freight lanes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks packaging circularity and green energy initiatives across freight lanes（GREEN）
information_points.content:
SUS-GREEN-VOP：For AeroCold Global Pharma Transit Alliance, the Packaging Fleet Sustainability Assessment for its active container fleet in 2025 indicates a reusable passive shipper packaging ratio of 65%, measured as the percentage of circulating thermal shippers certified for closed-loop reverse logistics refurbishment.
SUS-GREEN-X0T：For CryoTrans Intermodal Biologics Consortium, the Packaging Fleet Sustainability Assessment across its 2025 active container fleet records a reusable passive shipper packaging ratio of 65% of circulating thermal shippers certified for closed-loop reverse logistics refurbishment.
SUS-GREEN-0UL：For Vanguard Life Science Cold-Chain Solution, the Packaging Fleet Sustainability Assessment evaluated its 2025 active container fleet and determined a reusable passive shipper packaging ratio of 85% for circulating thermal shippers certified for closed-loop reverse logistics refurbishment.

information_points.title: Warehouse solar microgrid（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
SUS-SOLAR-LRR：According to the renewable energy production ledger for Vanguard Life Science Cold-Chain Solution's central packaging depot during 2025, hub rooftop solar power generation generated an annual on-site solar electric energy output of 250 MWh.
SUS-SOLAR-LCD：According to the renewable energy production ledger for CryoTrans Intermodal Biologics Consortium's central packaging depot during 2025, hub rooftop solar power generation totaled an annual on-site solar electric energy output of 350 MWh.
SUS-SOLAR-ZOP：According to the renewable energy production ledger for AeroCold Global Pharma Transit Alliance's central packaging depot during 2025, hub rooftop solar power generation reached an annual on-site solar electric energy output of 150 MWh.
